item.subject: science
item.stem:
In a school garden in Pune, Asha notices that the grass, rose bushes and a neem sapling all grow in the same flowerbed. None of them grows very tall, yet no plant dies out and the bed stays green all year.
Which statement best explains how competition keeps this small ecosystem balanced?

options.A: Competition makes all the plants share their food equally, so every plant grows at the same rate.
options.B: Competition for limited water, sunlight and space restricts how much each plant can grow, so no single plant takes over the bed.
options.C: Competition removes all weak plants immediately, leaving more resources for the strong ones.
options.D: Competition stops plants from using water and sunlight, so the resources are saved for the soil.
